abstract: BACKGROUND: Choriocarcinoma is a malignant tumor of the placenta. Life-saving hysterectomy was performed in two cases with choriocarcinoma who had profuse vaginal bleeding. CASE 1: A 25-year-old, gravida 3, para 1, woman was referred to our emergency clinic with the diagnosis of choriocarcinoma and massive vaginal bleeding. She had been transfused seven units of blood at the hospital where she was first admitted. Pelvic examination demonstrated heavy vaginal bleeding and a uterus equivalent to the size of 14 weeks of gestation. Her beta-hCG level was 560,000 mIU/ml. Despite four units of blood transfusion, she had a pulse rate of 130/min, arterial pressure of 90/60 mm/Hg and HCT of 19%. An emergency hysterectomy with vertical incision was performed. CASE 2: A 54-year-old, gravida 3, para 3, woman was referred to our clinic with heavy bleeding with the diagnosis of choriocarcinoma. She was scanned to look for possible metastases and pulmonary metastasis was detected. Chemotherapy was planned but as sudden vaginal bleeding began she was referred to the Gynecology Department. At pelvic examination a soft uterus the size of 20 weeks of gestation was palpated. The beta-hCG level was 554,700 mIU/ml. Due to hemodynamic instability and continuous vaginal bleeding an emergency hysterectomy was performed. CONCLUSION: Although chemotherapy is the cornerstone of treatment for choriocarcinoma, optimal treatment results may depend on the addition of surgery in selected circumstances. Hysterectomy is indicated in cases with life-threatening hemorrhage.
abstract_ja: 背景：絨毛癌は胎盤由来の悪性腫瘍である。大量の膣出血を呈した絨毛癌の2症例に対して、救命目的で子宮全摘術を施行した。症例1：25歳、妊娠3回・経産1回の女性が、絨毛癌および大量の膣出血の疑いで当院救急外来に紹介された。初診時の病院で7単位の輸血を受けていた。骨盤内診で多量の膣出血と妊娠14週相当の大きさの子宮を認めた。β-hCG値は560,000 mIU/mlであった。4単位の輸血後も脈拍130/分、動脈圧90/60 mmHg、ヘマトクリット19%であった。緊急で縦切開による子宮全摘術を施行した。症例2：54歳、妊娠3回・経産3回の女性が、絨毛癌の診断で大量出血の目的で当科に紹介された。転移の有無を評価するため画像検査を行い、肺転移が認められた。化学療法が計画されていたが、突然の膣出血が始まったため婦人科に紹介された。内診で妊娠20週相当の軟らかい子宮を触知した。β-hCG値は554,700 mIU/mlであった。血行動態の不安定さと持続する膣出血のため、緊急で子宮全摘術を施行した。結論：絨毛癌の治療の基本は化学療法であるが、選択された状況では手術の追加により最適な治療成績が得られる可能性がある。子宮全摘術は生命を脅かす出血に対して適応となる。
